# Houcine | Business, AI, Philosophy & Research Notes
> Personal website by Houcine: essays, research notes, and small projects about business, international markets, negotiation, AI-assisted research, and philosophy.

Curious readers, students, and self-learners who want to read about business decisions, international markets, negotiation, AI-assisted research, and philosophy, including how early-stage work develops.

Author and credentials: Houcine writes personal essays and documents self-directed research and software projects. This site does not claim formal academic or professional credentials.
Publishing: There is no fixed publishing schedule. New posts appear irregularly when Houcine has a piece of writing or a project result worth documenting. The site does not promise weekly or monthly updates.
Access: All currently published writing and project pages are free to read. There are no paid tiers, memberships, paywalls, or paid downloads.
Newsletter: There is no email newsletter or mailing list. Readers can follow new writing with the RSS feed at /feed.xml.
Submissions: There is no guest-author program or formal pitch/submission process, and guest posts are not currently being solicited. Technical feedback about the Ultimate Reality Researcher project can be directed to its public GitHub repository.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/): Overview of the site, its main topics, current work, publishing schedule, and access policy.
- [Now](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/now/): A current, editable snapshot of study options, research, and project work.
- [Topics](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/topics/): Archive pages that connect published items sharing a topic.
- [About](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/about/): Author background, current interests, learning goals, and project context.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/faq/): Direct answers about the site, content access, newsletter, posting frequency, and submissions.
- [Writing](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/writing/): Published essays and research notes.
- [Projects](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/projects/): Public software and research exercises.
- [RSS feed](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/feed.xml): Subscribe to new writing in a feed reader.

## Writing
- [International Business Got More Concrete When I Picked a Product](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/writing/learning-international-business/): What a small desk-research exercise on Tunisian olive oil and Singapore taught me about market-entry questions. Published 2026-10-16.
- [Persuasion Isn't Negotiation](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/writing/persuasion-vs-negotiation/): A distinction that matters when the goal is an agreement rather than a change of mind. Published 2026-09-22.

## Projects
- [Tunisian Olive Oil in Singapore: A First-Pass Market Study](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/projects/market-entry-hypothetical-product/): A desk-research exercise using trade data and Singapore's official import guidance to find out what needs checking before anyone recommends market entry. Status: Completed.
- [Ultimate Reality Researcher](https://houcine-notes.hssinmbarek6.workers.dev/projects/ultimate-reality-researcher/): A multi-stage AI research agent for comparing arguments about metaphysics and religion, including a failure I found in its own reasoning pipeline. Status: In progress.

## Notes on interpretation
- The site is a personal learning log, not a professional advisory service.
- The Tunisian olive oil and Singapore page is desk research, not a launched business or a validated market-entry recommendation.
- Ultimate Reality Researcher is experimental software. It does not establish the truth of any metaphysical or religious conclusion.
- No products, paid memberships, premium posts, or email newsletter are offered.
